free_tier.stated: QVAC is an open-source local-first peer-to-peer AI runtime; models run on the user's own hardware through qvac serve --openai; no hosted inference is offered and no per-token charge applies, but the reader supplies the hardware

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: the @qvac/ai-sdk-provider package, qvAC CLI and a local qvac serve --openai endpoint
chaining: pairs with the Vercel AI SDK against a local runtime; the scarce link is the user's own hardware, not a hosted service
binding_note: no hosted quota; the constraint is local hardware

identity_cost.detail: no account; the runtime is installed and run locally on the user's machine

reliability_note: no reliability event stated on the first-party page

evidence.proved: QVAC is a local-first peer-to-peer runtime running on the user's hardware
evidence.quote: QVAC is an open-source, cross-platform ecosystem for **local-first, peer-to-peer AI** — LLMs, embeddings, transcription, translation, speech, OCR, and image generation, all running on the user's own hardware.

notes: self-hosted last resort: a local-first P2P runtime with no hosted inference capacity of its own.
